Summary of all fixes made this session:

DapperConfiguration.cs — Added IntHandler to convert SQLite's Int64 to Int32. SQLite returns all integers as long; Dapper's constructor injection fails with unbox.any Int32 on a boxed long. This fixed 6 of the 7 failing tests (all FindByIdAsync calls).

LaneService.MoveAsync — Fixed position-move algorithm to use a 3-step approach: move lane to position=0 (temp, out of band), shift siblings, then move to final position. Required because UNIQUE(board_id, position) constraint prevents any ordering of "update moved lane + shift others" where positions collide transiently.

ILaneRepository + LaneRepository — Added SetPositionAsync for the unconditional final-position move in step 3.

LaneServiceTests fake — Added SetPositionAsync implementation and updated MovedToPosition tracking to reflect the final position set by SetPositionAsync.

Confirm what is left of this story from @specs/002-kanban-core/tasks.md specifically for US1

passing-implementation commit. All four test layers are required:
xUnit (unit + integration), RTL + Vitest (component), Playwright (e2e).

complete before any user story phase begins.

card resolve with exactly one winner (409 for the loser).
